purpose: Original FoamLab panda concept and articulated sprite atlas
referenceUse: Visual research of round panda proportions; no reference asset copied into site
conceptPrompt: Create an original exceptionally adorable baby giant panda game mascot, full body sitting facing forward, isolated on transparent background. Polished hand-crafted 2D PIXEL ART, consistent visible square pixel grid, as if a 64x64 sprite enlarged with nearest-neighbor, clean purposeful pixel clusters, NO dithering, no dirty texture. Character appeal is the priority: enormous soft round snow-white head with puffy lower cheeks, tiny round charcoal button ears partly embedded into the head, small glossy black eyes set within simple DIAGONALLY tilted black panda eye patches with one tiny white sparkle each, tiny dark triangular nose, a delicate tiny smiling w-shaped mouth, subtle pale pink cheeks. Head occupies about 65% of the silhouette, very squat rounded bean-shaped white body, almost no neck, very short chubby black mitten paws and bean feet. Hands rest against its little belly, one hand holds a tiny fresh bamboo leaf LOW by the belly, never across the eyes. White fur is clean near-white with extremely restrained cool ivory shading, black fur is deep charcoal with only one modest dark grey highlight, no brown fur, no grey sockets, no visible whites around pupils, no humanlike long torso or arms, no outlines like a skeleton, no sad tired eyes. Endearing, curious, warm expression, like an original premium kawaii sticker mascot or chubby panda plush turned into a charming sprite. Keep proportions spherical and cuddly, excellent silhouette, simple readable face. No outfit, no badge, no lettering, no watermark, no scenery, no pedestal, no frame, generous transparent margin. One single panda only, centered, no variants.
atlasPrompt: Create ONE production-ready PIXEL ART animation sprite-part atlas using the attached baby panda as the exact character reference. Preserve its cuddly round pear-shaped head, snow-white fur, glossy little eyes, pink cheeks, tiny nose and w smile, and plump plush-like proportions. Transparent background. EXACT layout: 4 equal square cells across, 2 equal square cells down, zero gaps, overall image aspect ratio 2:1. Each cell has generous transparent padding; every part fully inside its cell. NO text, NO labels, NO guides, NO borders. TOP ROW: four identical isolated HEADS, front view, without body or neck, centered at exactly the same place and same size in each cell. Head cell 1: sweet open glossy eyes and tiny w smile. Head cell 2: closed eyes, peaceful sleepy smile. Head cell 3: cheerful closed crescent eyes, happy smile. Head cell 4: open eyes and tiny open oval pink mouth singing. ALL four heads have identical shape, round small ears, white cheeks and black eye patches; only expression changes. Each head fills about 85 percent of its square cell width. BOTTOM ROW: cell 1 a standalone plump round white panda TORSO ONLY, no head, no arms, no feet, front view, small black shoulder band, fills 65 percent of square cell width, almost circular white tummy. Cell 2 a single very short chubby black MITTEN ARM, pointing down, no body, simple charcoal highlight, fills 45 percent of cell width and 60 percent height. Cell 3 a single rounded black SOLE/FOOT with three tiny toe pads and one soft gray central paw pad, front view, fills 60 percent of cell width and 45 percent height. Cell 4 a tiny green bamboo sprig with two leaves and a short stem, fills 45 percent cell width and 60 percent cell height. All parts use the exact same pixel grid: clean chunky square pixels and purposeful minimal shading, like a beautiful detailed 96x96 game sprite enlarged with nearest neighbor. No smooth vector shading, no gray eye sockets, no dirty fur. The atlas is for an animated website pet assembled from these pieces; precise equal cell placement and preserving the adorable reference identity are essential. Render only this single eight-cell sprite-part atlas.
runtime: panda-pixels.js draws atlas parts and animated expressions at 12 frames per second
